concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for continuous integrands
concepts.description: If f is continuous on [a,b], then F(x)=∫ₐˣf(t)dt has derivative f on (a,b); any antiderivative G of f satisfies ∫ₐᵇf=G(b)−G(a).

concepts.title: Integer
concepts.description: An integer is an element of the ordered ring ℤ, obtained by adjoining additive inverses to the natural numbers.

concepts.title: Integer polynomial
concepts.description: An integer polynomial is a real polynomial all of whose coefficients lie in ℤ.

concepts.title: Integration by parts for C¹ real functions
Sum of a nonnegative series
concepts.description: For aₙ≥0, define ∑ₙ≥1aₙ as the supremum of its finite partial sums; the value may be infinite.

concepts.title: π
concepts.description: π is the least positive zero of the real sine function and equals the circumference-to-diameter ratio of a Euclidean circle.

concepts.title: Irrationality of π
concepts.description: There are no integers a,b with b≠0 such that π=a/b.

concepts.title: Rational number
concepts.description: A real x is rational if x=a/b for integers a,b with b≠0; otherwise it is irrational.

concepts.title: Real number
concepts.description: A real number is an element of a complete ordered field ℝ; completeness means every nonempty subset bounded above has a least upper bound.

concepts.title: Real polynomial
concepts.description: A real polynomial is a finite sum ∑ⱼ₌₀ᵐaⱼxʲ with real coefficients and nonnegative integer m.

concepts.title: Real sequence
concepts.description: A real sequence is a function a:ℕ₊→ℝ, written (aₙ)ₙ≥1.

concepts.title: Convergent real series
concepts.description: The series ∑ₙ≥1aₙ converges to S if its sequence of partial sums converges to S.

concepts.title: Riemann integral
concepts.description: A bounded f:[a,b]→ℝ has Riemann integral I if all tagged Riemann sums approach I as the maximum length of the partition intervals tends to zero.

concepts.title: Limit of a real sequence
concepts.description: A sequence (aₙ) converges to L∈ℝ if for every ε>0 there is N such that n≥N implies abs(aₙ−L)<ε.

concepts.title: Real sine function
concepts.description: The sine function is defined by the everywhere convergent power series sin(x)=∑ₖ≥0(−1)ᵏx²ᵏ⁺¹/(2k+1)!.

concepts.title: Absolute continuity of measures
concepts.description: A measure ν is absolutely continuous with respect to μ on the same σ-algebra if μ(A)=0 implies ν(A)=0.

concepts.title: Addition theorem for spherical harmonics
concepts.description: For n≥3 and an orthonormal basis Y₁,…,Y_N of degree-k real spherical harmonics under probability-normalized area, ∑ⱼYⱼ(u)Yⱼ(v)=N G_{k,n}(u·v), where G_{k,n} is the normalized zonal Gegenbauer polynomial with G_{k,n}(1)=1. In particular the diagonal sum equals N. For n=2 the corresponding zonal polynomial is the Chebyshev polynomial cos(k arccos t).

concepts.title: Adjoint of a bounded Hilbert-space operator
concepts.description: The adjoint of a bounded operator T on a complex Hilbert space is the unique bounded operator T* satisfying ⟨Tx,y⟩=⟨x,T*y⟩ for every x,y.
